contenders.handicapper_notes: Ben Brisbourne-trained mare brings strong Victorian maiden form into this Tier 3.5 Riverina country maiden. She maps perfectly from barrier 3 with apprentice Cassidy Hill claiming valuable weight. Her best career efforts have come over 5 3/4f (1150m) on firm surfaces, including multiple placings at Wangaratta and Albury. Gets the run of the race stalking behind the leaders and should prove superior on the Good 4 surface.

Enters with strong recent form lines from Corowa, finishing a nose second over 6 1/2f before a solid third over 6f. Secures the coveted fence run from barrier 1, which holds a notable tactical advantage around the tight turns of Leeton. Ella Bent takes off valuable weight with her claim, ensuring she can box-seat right on the speed.

High-upside Canberra shipper trained by Todd Smart. Drops significantly in class after contesting the $148K Inglis Challenge as a 2yo. Resumes gelded with a sharp barrier trial placing at Canberra on September 4 under Sairyn Fawke. The class dropper in the race who could blow this country maiden field away if jumping cleanly.

Gary Colvin-trained mare resuming from a 5-month spell. Boasts 6 career minor placings in similar Riverina maiden company and picks up leading regional jockey Blaike Mcdougall. Prepped with a quiet Wagga trial and has previously performed very well when fresh.

The probable primary leader of the race with natural early gate speed. Led them up at Corowa over 6 1/2f two back before tiring late. Bradley Vale will look to cross and dictate terms on the rail, which suits the tight Leeton turning circuit.

Showed improved form at Griffith last start when holding on for third over 6f behind Pippie Pomar. Teaghan Martin retains the mount and will look to position midfield. Lacks winning punch (0 from 19) but fits into exotics.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Significant beneficiary of the scratching of Glowing Rapids, leaving her as the lone speed in the race. Drawn low in barrier 3, she possesses blazing gate speed and will dictate terms on the fence. Leeton tight turns and short 320m home straight heavily amplify front-runners on Good 4 ground. Given +6 lone speed pace bonus and is primed to lead wire-to-wire carrying just 55kg.

Tactical presser shipping from the premier Danielle Seib stable in Canberra (+3.0 hub shipper angle). Gets the perfect box-seat stalking passage from barrier 4 right behind the lone leader. Ran a solid 6th beaten only 4 lengths in BM68 company at Wyong on Sept 4 and previously beat top country sprinters over this distance bracket. Strong claims second.

Hardy veteran of 95 career starts with 13 victories. Already proven at this class level having taken out Wagga BM82 and Narrandera BM74 during the winter. Cassidy Hill knows him well and maintains continuity. While carrying top weight of 61kg is a minor query, he holds sufficient early speed to track the top two into the straight.

Highest raw class runner in the field, boasting over $332k in earnings and metropolitan Group form in prior preps. Drops sharply in venue class from Seymour BM62 and metropolitan winter benchmarks. However, his S running style leaves him vulnerable to being caught wide on the tight Leeton turns behind a controlled tempo. Top pilot Brodie Loy is engaged.

Second-up today after finishing 8th over an unsuitable 1000m dash at Queanbeyan. Carries 53kg after Dale Cole 2kg apprentice claim. Boasts previous metropolitan placings at Sandown and Cranbourne, but drawn outside and will need luck navigating the home turn from the rear.

Veteran mare drawn favorably in barrier 2. Recent trial win at Seymour was encouraging, but she was comfortably beaten first-up in Bendigo BM62 company. Facing a stiff class test against established Open/BM82 horses here; likely to struggle when pressure goes on.
